how_to_apply: Bring an application with full bio-data addressed to the Director, ICAR Central Tuber Crops Research Institute, Thiruvananthapuram.
Attach duly-attested photocopies of certificates and mark sheets from SSLC onwards, experience certificates, publications and additional qualifications.
Affix a recent passport size photograph on top of the application.
Produce original documents prior to the written test.
Attend on 19 November 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM.
important_instructions: Candidates are requested to be present 60 minutes before reporting time.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. in Agricultural Biotechnology/Biotechnology/Plant Biotechnology/Plant Molecular Biology from recognized universities. Age limit: Between 21 to 45 years (as on 1 June 2026) Age relaxation: rule Applicable as per ICAR rules Desirable: Experience in tissue culture/ Plant genome editing/ Transgenics.

content_sections.text: Purely on contract basis and co-terminus with the project. Initial appointment is for up to 31st March 2027 (likely to be extended).

content_sections.heading: How Will CTCRI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written test Interview Written test-cum interview Based on academic performance, additional relevant qualifications, research / technology incubation experience and performance in interview.

content_sections.heading: CTCRI Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the test or interview. Appointing Authority may cancel or postpone the interview without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Full bio-data application Duly-attested photocopies of certificates and mark sheets from SSLC onwards Experience certificates Publications/additional qualifications Recent passport size photograph Original documents No objection certificate from employer if employed elsewhere

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CTCRI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Bring an application with full bio-data addressed to the Director, ICAR Central Tuber Crops Research Institute, Thiruvananthapuram. Attach duly-attested photocopies of certificates and mark sheets from SSLC onwards, experience certificates, publications and additional qualifications. Affix a recent passport size photograph on top of the application. Produce original documents prior to the written test. Attend on 19 November 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates are requested to be present 60 minutes before reporting time.
